translations./garage/brief: Torque, efficiency, and top speed reveal three gearing tradeoffs. Predict the result, then let RO-1 demonstrate.
translations./prediction/hint: Predict first. Faster gearing raises top speed, but launch force, grade ability, energy, and braking all pay a price.
translations./prediction/choices/0/text: The high-speed motor wins the straight
translations./prediction/choices/0/feedback: Check whether the course is long enough to reach top speed, then inspect energy and stopping distance.
translations./prediction/choices/1/feedback: Stall force improves launch, while the lower gear ratio limits final speed.
translations./running/normal_line: RO-1: Learning the new motor’s personality.
translations./debrief/success_summary: Speed, torque, and efficiency share one scorecard. Gearing offers no free lunch.
translations./debrief/failure_summary: Try another motor or leave more room in the build budget.
translations./debrief/evidence_caption: Time and energy come from the simulation, not flavor text.
translations./debrief/failure_titles/timeout: Trial failed: calibration pad not reached
translations./prediction/choices/2/text: The efficient motor is best overall
translations./prediction/choices/2/feedback: When time pressure is low, lower energy use may matter more than absolute speed.
